title: Contents Packout & Storage Pack-Back Carry Percentage for Multifamily and Condo Units
content:
Carrying boxes into a unit costs more than into a house. On the Contents Packout & Storage pack-back box line of a return: **when the company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address is for a multifamily unit property, the pack-back box rate carries the multifamily carry percentage; when it is for a condo unit property, the condo carry percentage; when it is for any other property type, or no company rebuild contract is read at that address, no carry percentage applies.**

The company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address is the one at that address on the job's own claim file, or with no claim file when the job has none, and among those the one furthest along, taking a closed contract first, then a final invoiced, substantially complete, in construction, permitted, signed and proposed one in that order; a cancelled contract is never read; the company keeps one rebuild contract per claim file and address, added scope for the same claim and address being written as a change order on it, so no two contracts share that place in the order.

## Carry percentages

| Property type on the Reconstruction contract read | Carry percentage on the pack-back box rate |
|---|---|
| multifamily unit | 15 percent |
| condo unit | 8 percent |
| any other property type | none |
| no company rebuild contract read at the address | none |

## Which contract is read (cases)

- One closed and one cancelled contract at the address on the job's claim file: the closed one is read; a cancelled contract is never read.
- One contract on the job's claim file at the address, in construction: it is read.
- A contract at the same address on a different claim file: not read for this job.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a pack-back box rate taken as 10.00, a multifamily unit contract makes it 11.50 per box and a condo unit contract 10.80.
